She received her Ph.D. from Harbin Institute of Technology, and her doctoral dissertation was nominated for the "19th Outstanding Doctoral Dissertation of Harbin Institute of Technology". In 2020, she completed her postdoctoral research at the Information and Communication Engineering Postdoctoral Station of Harbin Engineering University (with an "Excellent" rating). She is a leader of a provincial first-class major, a "Leading Talent" among municipal high-level talents, a provincial high-level talent, and a review expert for the National Natural Science Foundation of China. Her research mainly focuses on remote sensing image analysis and processing, as well as machine learning and artificial intelligence. Over the past five years, she has led and participated in more than ten projects, including projects funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China, the National 863 Program, and other provincial and ministerial programs. Some of the completed results of her projects were rated as "domestically leading level". She has published more than 80 papers in journals such as IEEE TGRS, Pattern Recognition, Knowledge Based Systems, Expert Systems with Applications, and IEEE JSTARS; published one academic monograph (rated a "Provincial Excellent Book" in 2021); and co-translated two works, "Satellite Data Compression" and "Remote Sensing Digital Image Analysis: An Introduction" (Fifth Edition). She has applied for more than 30 invention patents, with 14 granted as the first inventor. She has led student teams to win 2 national third prizes and 9 provincial prizes in the "Huawei Cup" China Intelligent Design Competition, and was awarded the "Outstanding Supervisor" title by the Computer Education Research Association of Chinese Universities. 招生说明：每年招收硕士生4~5名，博士生1名，欢迎同学报名联系！有意愿者请把简历发至本人邮箱，期待你我能共同成长！ Admission Notice: I recruit 4-5 master's students and 1 doctoral student each year.
